8.4.24 Eth_Receive
[SWS_Eth_00095] Definition of API function Eth_Receive ⌈
Service Name
Eth_Receive
Syntax
void Eth_Receive (
uint8 CtrlIdx,
uint8 QueueIdx,
Eth_RxStatusType* RxStatusPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x0B
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different queues. Non Reentrant for the same queue.
CtrlIdx
Index of the controller within the context of the Driver
Parameters (in)
QueueIdx
Specifies the related queue
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
RxStatusPtr
Indicates whether a frame has been received and if so, whether
more frames are available for the related queue.
Return value
None
Description
Receive a frame from the related queue.
Available via
Eth.h
⌋
[SWS_Eth_00132] ⌈Eth_Receive() shall check the controller mode for being active
(ETH_MODE_ACTIVE). If the check fails, the function shall return directly.⌋
[SWS_Eth_00099] ⌈Eth_Init() shall be called before Eth_Receive().⌋
